themes.label: AI infrastructure capital expenditure buildout
themes.rationale: Microsoft is among the largest hyperscaler spenders on data center capacity, custom silicon, and power for AI workloads; its capex trajectory and depreciation drag are directly tied to this multi-company investment wave.

themes.label: Enterprise cloud migration and infrastructure spend
themes.rationale: Azure's growth is a direct beneficiary of ongoing enterprise workload migration to public cloud, a durable multi-year shift shared with other hyperscalers and enterprise software vendors.

themes.label: Generative AI product monetization
themes.rationale: Microsoft is embedding AI copilots and OpenAI-derived models across its software and cloud stack, testing whether AI features convert into incremental seat and consumption revenue industry-wide.

themes.label: Grid electrification and power constraints
themes.rationale: Data center power demand from Microsoft's AI buildout is straining grid capacity and driving utility investment and power purchase agreements, linking it to the broader electrification/power-supply theme.
